title: Deciding superellipticity and computing the Weierstrass normal form
summary: Let \( \mathcal{S}_{g,n} \subset \mathcal{M}_g \) be the locus of curves of genus \( g \geq 2 \) admitting a model \( y^n = h(x) \) with \( h \) separable; such curves $C$ have a cyclic group \( C_n \leq \operatorname{Aut}(C) \) of order \( n \) with \( C/C_n \cong \mathbb{P}^1 \). % We give an algorithm which, given an absolutely irreducible plane model \( F(x,y) = 0 \) of a curve \( C \) over a field \( k_0 \) of characteristic zero, decides for which \( n \) the curve lies in \( \mathcal{S}_{g,n} \) and returns a model \( y^n = h(x) \) together with the birational transformation to it.
